subject: Mutual action map + staggered signature windows for Meridian pilot
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action map + pilot signature windows

Hi Alex —

Good to connect yesterday in the demo. Per our discussion I put together a concise mutual action map (attached) that maps evaluation checkpoints to procurement and legal milestones. High-level notes: 

- We recommend a staggered-signature approach for the pilot: sign MSA first (may/should include core commercial terms), run pilot under a limited order form, and then DPA signature either concurrently with the order form or immediately after depending on your legal team's review speed.
- Key gating evidence: SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, and a short runbook showing data residency controls.
- Timeline we penciled: evaluation completion (3 weeks), procurement approval (2 weeks), legal review + MSA redlines (1–2 weeks). Order form execution targeted in week of 2025-07-07.

Attachments: Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates), redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (evidence stub).

Can you confirm procurement's preferred signature cadence and whether Meridian prefers to surface any mandatory DPA clauses up-front? If helpful, we can propose two close-path options (fast lane vs standard) and tag the MAP accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to locking the path.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
Attachment: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (pdf, 6 pages)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@meridianhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@meridianhealth.com, Megan Wilson <m.wilson@wilsongray.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action map + pilot signature windows

Thanks Jasmine — the MAP looks helpful, appreciate the clear owners. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

1) Procurement prefers MSA + Order Form signed together where possible; they say splitting risks having the order delayed. That said, they will accept a two-step if MSA redlines are light.
2) Legal (copied) flagged two DPA items they want called out early: subprocessor list & data deletion obligations. Megan — can you confirm whether Meridian needs those on the MSA or as a separate DPA?
3) Evidence: SOC2 summary is good; we also need an architectural diagram that shows PHI segmentation for the pilot scope. Will Redwood provide a short network/DataFlow diagram?

Proposed internal timeline from Meridian: procurement review (to 6/20), legal redlines (to 6/27), exec signoff (by 7/2). That would put final signature target around the first week of July.

If Redwood can provide an accelerated MSA redline response cycle (48–72 hrs) and the network diagram, we can likely meet the fast-lane target.

Alex
Head of Partnerships, Meridian Health
alex.morgan@meridianhealth.com

Looping in to confirm what we can turn around this week. Quick points: 

- I can shepherd MSA redlines once Legal hands us the suggested edits. I'll prioritize and send consolidated responses within 48 hours.
- Engineering can produce the PHI-segmentation diagram and a 1-page runbook (data flow + retention) by EOD Tuesday (2025-06-10). Ben — can you provide the SOC2 summary and the standard subprocessor list?

Ben (cc): please attach the SOC2 one-pager and latest subprocessors file. Also advise if we should pre-populate standard DPA clauses (subprocessor, deletion, incident response) in the order form to reduce back-and-forth.

I'll also draft two MAP lanes: Fast-lane (MSA + Order Form in parallel; 7/2 sign) and Standard (MSA first, DPA final; 7/10 sign). We can present both to Meridian with recommendation.

Thanks — will update the MAP worksheet when the attachments are ready.

Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks for the timeline. Quick status update and ask: 

- Deliverables completed: SOC2 one-pager (attached), PHI segmentation diagram, and updated MAP with two lanes (Fast / Standard). All attached to this message.
- Legal note: Megan, we included the DPA clauses Alex flagged inline in the MAP and attached a pre-populated DPA text you can redline. If Meridian prefers DPA as a stand-alone agreement, we can split those clauses out — just let us know.
- Requested commitment: If Meridian can commit to the 48–72 hour turnaround on MSA redlines, our commercial/CS teams will prioritize the order form build and prepare the DocuSign packet by 2025-06-20. That gets us on track for a potential signature week of 2025-07-06 (fast-lane).

Next steps: 
1) Alex / Procurement confirm preferred cadence (MSA+Order Form together or two-step) by 2025-06-16.
2) Megan / Meridian legal to indicate DPA placement preference (inline vs separate) by 2025-06-18.
3) Redwood to deliver final DocuSign packet for Meridian review by 2025-06-20 (assuming quick redline cycles).

Thanks everyone — attaching files and the updated MAP.

Best,
